title: bug: moe-proxy comparableProjectPath maps /mnt/<d> on the raw string, so a relative or non-normalized MOE_PROJECT_PATH is refused as "a different project"
description:
packages/moe-proxy/src/utils.ts comparableProjectPath runs the /mnt/<letter> regex on the raw string, so a path that has to go through path.resolve is never mapped. With cwd /mnt/d/projexts/app: '.' becomes '/mnt/d/projexts/app', '/mnt/d/projexts/app/.' becomes 'd:/projexts/app/.', and '/mnt/d/projexts/app/sub/..' becomes 'd:/projexts/app/sub/..'. All of these differ from 'd:/projexts/app', so readDaemonInfoResult answers "daemon.json belongs to a different project" and the proxy exits. Reproduced with tsx while working on task-a60a1616 QA round 1. It is non-destructive, and the launchers pass absolute paths.
Fix: resolve first, then map; on win32, posix-normalize a raw /mnt path. This mirrors the daemon fix in task-a60a1616 (packages/moe-daemon/src/index.ts comparableProjectPath, test rows X9/X10).
definitionOfDone: With cwd /mnt/d/x, moe-proxy comparableProjectPath gives 'd:/x' for '.', '/mnt/d/x/.', '/mnt/d/x/sub/..' and '/mnt/d//x', matching '/mnt/d/x' and 'D:\\x'.
On win32, a raw '/mnt/<d>/…' path is posix-normalized before it is mapped.
Existing moe-proxy utils tests stay green. New rows in packages/moe-proxy cover relative and non-normalized inputs and are red before the fix.
